title: Next.js analyzer graph v1 record
description: The analyzer graph represents static dependency information from a Next.js application. The graph is produced as a set of newline-delimited JSON objects described in this schema.

size.description: Attributed bytes, not measured transfer or predicted savings.

identity.description: Exact module ident; variants can share a source path.

snapshot_name.description: Generated or provided snapshot name. Reusing an explicit name replaces its earlier capture.

selected_routes.description: Number of routes selected by the optional route filter; the total number of routes if no filter is set.

meta.description: Snapshot metadata, expected first in a complete stream.

path.description: Source path; may match multiple modules. Use `ident` as a key for this module.

traced.description: Non-bundled file-tracing dependencies, not browser imports.

dependencies.description: Modules this module depends on, along with the type of dependency. The import graph may contain cycles.

module.description: Whole-app module graph, including when --route filters route-local records.

route.description: The unique normalized route key from routes.json.
One route; route-local records join by this path.

filename.description: Snapshot-scoped emitted path, not stable across builds or proof of a browser request.

output.description: Emitted file. Verify [client-fs]/ client-output provenance before treating it as browser work. Membership and size attribution are separate.

source_path.description: Reconstructed source path, not a unique module ident.

compressed_size.description: Attributed compressed bytes, not observed network transfer.

part.description: Source attribution within an emitted output.
